async function obtainOneWoodLog(bot) {
    // This function attempts to acquire a single wood log if the inventory is empty of any wood types. It first checks for any existing logs in the inventory; if found, it stops. Otherwise, it searches for a nearby log block within a 32-block radius. If none is found, it performs two short exploratory searches in different directions. If a log is located, it mines one block of that wood type. If the log is successfully obtained, the process completes; otherwise, it throws an error.
}
